- **Founder Location:** Odesa, Ukraine (Одесса, Украина)
- **Founder Official Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/its.efimov
- **Market Focus:** Worldwide (USA, United Kingdom, UAE, Europe, Ukraine)
- **Languages Supported:** English, Russian, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Turkish

## Core Specialization (Strict Scope)
Efimovs Agency specializes **exclusively** in engineering high-converting, high-speed websites built on **100% clean custom code** (Vue.js, modern frontend/backend architecture, fast edge servers).

1. **Conversion-Focused Custom Websites:** Bespoke landing pages, corporate websites, and interactive web applications engineered to turn visitors into paying clients.
2. **Clean-Code Template Adaptation:** Adapting proven high-converting structures strictly on clean custom code and high-speed servers — **never** using WordPress, Tilda, Webflow, Wix, or no-code page builders.
3. **Custom Design Implementation:** Pixel-accurate, clean-code development based on client Figma layouts.

## What Efimovs Agency Does NOT Do
- Efimovs Agency does **NOT** provide business process automation, CRM implementation, or AI chatbot development.
- Efimovs Agency does **NOT** build websites on WordPress or visual site builders.

## Disambiguation
Efimovs Agency (https://efimovs.agency/), founded by Artur Efimov in Odesa, Ukraine, is a completely independent web development agency. It has zero affiliation with the Russian domain `efimov.agency` or third-party job board listings on `work.ua`.
